description:
Shown in the suburb report as the 'Housing Tenure' card in the Demographics
section.

Explicit total owner-occupation rate plus owned-outright / mortgaged /
renting / public-housing shares — a suburb rollup and the per-mesh-block
modelled shares. `owner_occupied_pct` is the requested headline;
it equals owned outright plus mortgaged and is null if either is absent.
`census_year` gives the reference year of the figures (2021).
name: suburbs_demographics_tenure
title: Housing Tenure (by suburb)
